description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of video categories within a dataset. The chart contains 12 slices, each representing a different video category. The categories and their approximate proportions are as follows: People/Blogs at 17.2%, Howto at 9.7%, Education at 8.7%, Entertainment at 13.9%, Film & Animation at 4.6%, Sports at 7.7%, Gaming at 6.4%, Travel & Events at 4.6%, Comedy at 5.6%, Science & Technology at 6.4%, News & Politics at 4.3%, and Pets & Animals at 3.9%, with a final category of Autos & Vehicles at 4.8% and Music at 2.3%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion, though this is not strictly maintained. A legend is not present, as the category labels are directly on the chart.
